dedupe_keys.name: clean development mechanism waste project documents and coded barriers 2004 2014

description: This deposit contains 432 waste-management project design documents registered under the Clean Development Mechanism during 2004–2014. André Bufoni and collaborators assembled projects from seven waste-sector industries and coded 890 text fragments into technological, financial, staffing, regulatory and sociopolitical barriers. The archive preserves the NVivo 10 project, analysis and sample statistics for qualitative content analysis. Mendeley offers the RAR file free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage follows the registered projects across countries, not a complete global waste-facility inventory. Programme selection and retrospective coding are limitations when estimating how common these barriers are outside the sampled projects. Modellers could derive institutional constraints or compare barrier assumptions in waste-investment and agent-based simulations. data-what-a-waste-global-database provides complementary waste-system context, without a verified project-level crosswalk. NVivo-compatible software is needed for the native project. No document archive was downloaded, coded passages were not inspected and inter-coder reliability was not checked.
name: Clean Development Mechanism waste-project documents and coded barriers, 2004–2014
